what: XGP pilot round 4 (final round, validation only); pre-registered before any run
disclosure: The round-4 design was informed by round 3's validation results (folds 0-1), a read-only validation diagnostic of per-layer importance at theta0, and the Step 9A test-set analysis (as round 3). All round-4 tuning and selection use real HARTH inner-validation windows of folds 0 and 1 only; HAR70+, the folds' test subjects, synthetic older-like data and age information are never used by the method or the selection. The 9A-ext baseline-only settings run on the test grid in 9B, after this decision, and cannot change it.
amendment: Amendment 1 (2026-11-23, before --prepare and before any round-4 run): all synthetic older-like data removed from round 4; XGP is group-agnostic (optional group label per window, default = subject): importance = mean of the k = 3 worst groups, fine-tuning = group DRO over the training subjects, every baseline gets the same DRO as a control (*_kd_dro); validation = LCI_val, worst-subject LCI_val and F1_val on real inner-val windows; older vs general and walking-aid vs not are evaluation-only in 9B. Reason: the older-like proxy added nothing in round 3, and the method must not depend on one dataset's groups.
rules: Per mode and regime (no_finetune, kd100, kd5), levels = the mode's levels in that regime, means over folds 0-1 x seeds 0-2 (6 paired runs; deterministic starts count once per seed). Metrics on real inner-val windows only. 1 Baselines: unstructured l1, l1_recon, lamp_recon; structured l1_filter, l1_filter_recon, taylor_recon; in the fine-tuned regimes also their DRO controls (*_kd_dro). B_F1 = the highest mean F1_val among them per level. 2 Eligible = mean F1_val >= B_F1 - 1 pt at every level. 3 Final: unstructured candidates xgp, l1_xb_recon, xgp_lamp, xgp_xb (tie order), structured xgp_s; the eligible candidate with the highest mean LCI_val over levels, ties within 0.005 -> earlier in order; none -> no final. 4 A beats B iff (a) mean LCI_val gain (over levels and runs) >= 0.02, (b) A higher in >= 5 of 6 paired (fold, seed) runs (each run averaged over levels), (c) at every level mean F1_val of A >= mean F1_val of B - 1 pt, (d) mean worst-subject LCI_val of A (over levels) >= B's - 0.01. 5 Replacement (unstructured, per regime): round 4's final replaces round 3's (xgp_r3, scored with these metrics) only if it beats it; otherwise round 3 is final there; with no round-3 final there, round 4's final is adopted if it exists. 6 Claim: 'beats the baselines' only if the adopted final beats the baseline (DRO controls included) with the highest mean LCI_val. 7 Structured: xgp_s frozen if eligible; enters 9B only if its pilot finished and was decided by 27 Nov morning. 8 Seed SD per method reported; a regime with missing runs has no round-4 decision (round 3 stays final).
groups: subject (default of har/xgp4.default_groups); no age / HAR70+ / synthetic data
